sessions.title: Opening Keynote
sessions.reason: Start together with GitHub's direction for AI-assisted delivery. Identify announcements Principal Financial's developers, platform engineers, and security teams should explore further; separate available capabilities from future plans.

sessions.title: Agentic engineering past the pilot: An enterprise playbook
sessions.reason: Compare enterprise patterns for scaling agentic engineering beyond isolated pilots. Focus on accountable ownership, developer experience, and controls that can be embedded in Principal Financial's engineering workflows.

sessions.title: Supercharge Copilot code review with custom review instructions
sessions.reason: Learn how recurring review feedback can become repository-specific Copilot instructions. Evaluate how Principal Financial teams could capture domain conventions, reduce review noise, and retain human responsibility for important changes.
sessions.note: Tight transfer: 20 minutes, including an estimated 15-minute walk and 5-minute early arrival. Allow extra time for queues.

sessions.title: Beyond correct: Making code quality worth acting on
sessions.reason: Examine how to make automated quality findings useful enough for developers to act on. Bring back practical ideas for reducing repeated findings, presenting fixes in context, and evaluating feedback quality across Principal Financial repositories.

sessions.title: The Low Orbit Agentic Cannon: Scaling Copilot through internal tooling
sessions.reason: Galaxy offers a financial-services example of scaling Copilot through internal tooling. Consider how reusable enablement and engineering discipline can support Principal Financial teams beyond one-off prompts.
sessions.note: Replaces the 11:30 AM and 12:10 PM recommendations on this day, including transfer time. Official guidance: arrive about 20 minutes early; seating is not guaranteed.

sessions.title: The factory mindset: Agentic workflows in production
sessions.reason: Compare governed agent workflows across enterprise settings. For Principal Financial's platform and delivery teams, focus on auditability, human approval gates, and the operating changes needed to move from experimentation into dependable use.

sessions.title: What does shift left mean in an agentic world?
sessions.reason: Explore the evidence and human oversight needed when agents participate in delivery. Use the demo to align developers and security teams on reviewable changes, clear accountability, and controls early in the workflow.

sessions.title: Disrupting supply chain attacks: A threat framework for GitHub Actions
sessions.reason: Map supply-chain attack techniques to workflow and runner controls. Give Principal Financial's platform and security teams a shared framework for evaluating CI/CD credentials, network exposure, and release-pipeline protections.

sessions.title: Beyond "hours saved": How AMD and ING measure AI at enterprise scale
sessions.reason: Choose AMD and ING's measurement discussion when evaluating AI adoption and delivery outcomes is more important than the parallel Actions threat-framework session. Compare useful measures for Principal Financial without relying on hours-saved claims alone.
sessions.note: Replaces the 2:30 PM recommendation on this day, including transfer time. Tight transfer into the 3:30 PM session: allow 20 minutes including travel and early arrival.

sessions.title: One PM, four weeks, full compliance: How itti shipped a banking product with agents
sessions.reason: Compare a banking-product team's use of human approval gates and traceability. Useful for Principal Financial colleagues prioritizing regulated delivery patterns over the parallel CI/CD security discussion.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor
sessions.note: Replaces the 2:30 PM recommendation on this day, including transfer time. Tight transfer into the 3:30 PM session: allow 20 minutes including travel and early arrival.

sessions.title: PATs, rulesets, and IP allowlists: How Confluent secured GitHub Enterprise Cloud
sessions.reason: Compare Confluent's experience with PATs, rulesets, and IP allowlists. Focus on practical rollout, ownership, and developer friction when making repository and identity controls consistent across Principal Financial teams.

sessions.title: The human side of AI: How building community drove 94% Copilot adoption
sessions.reason: Learn how another financial-services organization used community and shared practice to encourage Copilot adoption. Adapt useful enablement approaches across Principal Financial teams without assuming another company's adoption rate predicts your results.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor
sessions.note: Tight transfer: 20 minutes, including an estimated 15-minute walk and 5-minute early arrival. Allow extra time for queues.

sessions.title: Opening the black box: Tracing, debugging, and fixing your GitHub Actions agents
sessions.reason: Explore Sentry traces for tool calls, failures, latency, and token use in GitHub Actions agents. Evaluate how production evidence can improve debugging and agent evaluations; this is an observability pattern, not a commitment to any particular monitoring product.

sessions.title: Visa's Zero-Secrets Initiative: no hardcoded secrets, no exceptions
sessions.reason: Compare Visa's enterprise approach to credential-risk reduction, policy ownership, and exception handling. Choose this financial-services peer case when prevention practices are a higher priority than the morning observability and remediation demos.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor
sessions.note: Replaces the 9:00 AM and 9:40 AM recommendations on this day, including transfer time.

sessions.title: Resolve your security alerts faster with GitHub Copilot
sessions.reason: See how agent-generated fixes can turn alert investigation into a reviewable pull request. For Principal Financial developers and AppSec teams, focus on validation, remediation ownership, and the review controls needed before accepting a proposed fix.

sessions.title: The 2am RCA Agent: Architecting AI that investigates, not hallucinates
sessions.reason: Study an incident-investigation agent that uses deterministic evidence gathering and lets the model narrate the results. A practical alternative for Principal Financial operations and platform engineers interested in auditable, replayable investigations.
sessions.note: Replaces the 9:00 AM and 9:40 AM recommendations on this day, including transfer time. Official guidance: arrive about 20 minutes early; seating is not guaranteed.

sessions.title: Open PRs, don't merge them: Fine-grained authorization for hosted MCP servers
sessions.reason: Study per-identity authorization for hosted MCP tools, including allowing an agent to open a pull request without merging it. Compare the pattern with Principal Financial's desired separation of agent actions and human approvals.
sessions.note: Replaces the 9:40 AM and 10:40 AM recommendations on this day, including transfer time. Official guidance: arrive about 20 minutes early; seating is not guaranteed.

sessions.title: We shipped governance: What broke, what worked, what we’d do again
sessions.reason: Study governance implemented through pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and automated checks. Compare how platform teams made controls trustworthy and usable, with lessons for Principal Financial's engineering standards and developer enablement.
sessions.note: Official guidance: arrive about 20 minutes early; seating is not guaranteed.

sessions.title: Your CI has full internet access. GitHub Actions firewall changes that.
sessions.reason: Examine outbound request visibility and allowlists for GitHub Actions workflows. Focus on how Principal Financial's platform and security teams can evaluate egress evidence, build dependencies, and controlled network access; confirm feature availability for your environment separately.

sessions.title: People, process, and GitHub: Eliminating 90% of enterprise AppSec risk
sessions.reason: Use Manulife's regulated-enterprise experience to connect immediate developer feedback with risk visibility and accountable remediation. Discuss practices Principal Financial can evaluate without assuming the case study's numeric outcomes will transfer.
sessions.note: Official guidance: arrive about 20 minutes early; seating is not guaranteed. Tight transfer: 35 minutes, including an estimated 15-minute walk and 20-minute early arrival. Allow extra time for queues.

sessions.title: Treat your AI context as infrastructure
sessions.reason: Learn how to standardize instructions, skills, agents, and MCP as managed context infrastructure. Useful for Principal Financial developers and enablement teams looking to distribute reusable practices consistently.
sessions.note: Replaces the 12:35 PM recommendation on this day, including transfer time. Tight transfer into the 2:00 PM session: allow 20 minutes including travel and early arrival.

sessions.title: Closing Keynote
sessions.reason: Reconvene around the closing program and turn the most useful ideas into team follow-ups on quality, secure delivery, agent operations, and adoption. The detailed keynote program is still developing; no particular announcement is assumed.
